import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store import Receipt, ReceiptLine
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_empty_receipt():
    """An empty cart gives a receipt with no lines and every total 0."""
    cart = Cart()
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    assert isinstance(receipt, Receipt)  # receipt() returns a Receipt
    assert receipt.lines == []  # no lines for empty cart
    assert receipt.subtotal_cents == 0  # empty subtotal 0
    assert receipt.discount_cents == 0  # empty discount 0
    assert receipt.shipping_cents == 0  # empty shipping 0
    assert receipt.tax_cents == 0  # empty tax 0
    assert receipt.total_cents == 0  # empty total 0


def test_issue_example_discounts():
    """The cart's total discount is split across lines in proportion to gross_cents."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=2000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="c", name="C", price_cents=3005))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 1000+2000+3005=6005; discount floor(6005*10/100)=600
    # floors: 600*1000//6005=99 rem5505, 600*2000//6005=199 rem5005, 600*3005//6005=300 rem1500; leftover 2 to largest remainders
    assert [line.discount_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [100, 200, 300]  # 99+1, 199+1, 300


def test_issue_example_taxes():
    """The cart's tax is split across lines the same way, in proportion to net_cents."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=2000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="c", name="C", price_cents=3005))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # nets 1000-100=900, 2000-200=1800, 3005-300=2705 sum 5405; tax (5405*8+50)//100=432
    # floors: 432*900//5405=71 rem5045, 432*1800//5405=143 rem4685, 432*2705//5405=216 rem1080; leftover 2 to first two
    assert [line.tax_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [72, 144, 216]  # 71+1, 143+1, 216


def test_issue_gross_with_quantity():
    """gross_cents = price_cents * qty for the line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="bulk", name="Bulk", price_cents=250, qty=4))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    assert isinstance(receipt.lines[0], ReceiptLine)  # lines are ReceiptLine
    assert receipt.lines[0].qty == 4  # qty preserved 4
    assert receipt.lines[0].gross_cents == 1000  # 250*4=1000
    assert receipt.lines[0].discount_cents == 100  # floor(1000*10/100)=100 single line gets all
    assert receipt.lines[0].net_cents == 900  # 1000-100=900
    assert receipt.lines[0].tax_cents == 72  # (900*8+50)//100=72 single line gets all


def test_issue_discount_largest_remainder():
    """Leftover cents are given one at a time to the lines with the largest remainder."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=101))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="c", name="C", price_cents=300))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 101+200+300=601; discount floor(601*10/100)=60
    # floors: 60*101//601=10 rem50, 60*200//601=19 rem581, 60*300//601=29 rem571; leftover 2 to lines 2 and 3
    assert [line.discount_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [10, 20, 30]  # 10, 19+1, 29+1


def test_issue_discount_tie_earlier_line():
    """Ties going to the earlier line in the cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=505))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=505))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # subtotal 505+505=1010; discount floor(1010*10/100)=101
    # floors: 101*505//1010=50 rem505 each; sum 100 leftover 1 to earlier line on tie
    assert [line.discount_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [51, 50]  # 50+1, 50


def test_issue_tax_split_proportional():
    """The cart's tax is split across lines in proportion to net_cents."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=101))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="c", name="C", price_cents=300))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    # nets 101-10=91, 200-20=180, 300-30=270 sum 541; tax (541*8+50)//100=43
    # floors: 43*91//541=7 rem126, 43*180//541=14 rem166, 43*270//541=21 rem249; leftover 1 to largest remainder
    assert [line.tax_cents for line in receipt.lines] == [7, 14, 22]  # 7, 14, 21+1


def test_issue_receipt_totals_match_cart():
    """Receipt totals equal the cart's own numbers."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=2000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="c", name="C", price_cents=3005))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    assert receipt.subtotal_cents == 6005  # 1000+2000+3005=6005
    assert receipt.subtotal_cents == cart.subtotal_cents()  # equals cart subtotal
    assert receipt.discount_cents == 600  # floor(6005*10/100)=600
    assert receipt.discount_cents == cart.discount_cents()  # equals cart discount
    assert receipt.shipping_cents == 0  # discounted 5405>=5000 so 0
    assert receipt.shipping_cents == cart.shipping_cents()  # equals cart shipping
    assert receipt.tax_cents == 432  # (5405*8+50)//100=432
    assert receipt.tax_cents == cart.tax_cents()  # equals cart tax
    assert receipt.total_cents == 5837  # 5405+0+432=5837
    assert receipt.total_cents == cart.total_cents()  # equals cart total


def test_issue_lines_in_cart_order():
    """lines (list of ReceiptLine, in cart order)."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="z", name="Z", price_cents=100))
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="m", name="M", price_cents=300))
    receipt = cart.receipt()
    assert [line.sku for line in receipt.lines] == ["z", "a", "m"]  # insertion order z,a,m


def test_contract_percent_rounds_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1005))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 100  # floor(1005*10/100)=floor(100.5)=100


def test_contract_fixed_requires_minimum():
    """A fixed coupon takes a flat amount off, but only when the subtotal is at least the minimum."""
    low = Cart()
    low.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1999))
    low.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    assert low.discount_cents() == 0  # 1999<2000 so 0
    high = Cart()
    high.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=2000))
    high.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    assert high.discount_cents() == 500  # 2000>=2000 so 500


def test_contract_shipping_threshold():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    low = Cart()
    low.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=4999))
    assert low.shipping_cents() == 599  # discounted 4999<5000 so 599
    high = Cart()
    high.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=5000))
    assert high.shipping_cents() == 0  # discounted 5000>=5000 so 0


def test_contract_tax_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=19))
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 2  # (19*8+50)//100=(152+50)//100=2, floor would be 1


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=3000))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):  # second coupon raises CouponError
        cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")
